summary_md: **Vishal Pandey ([@_vMyth](https://x.com/_vMyth/status/2116379641808367878))** explains **confine** from agentutils. It runs Claude Code in a copy-on-write fork of the repo without access to SSH keys, and `fsdiff` exports the changes as a Git patch. The network is not restricted, so readable data can still leave ([penberg/agentutils](https://github.com/penberg/agentutils)).
